blocks.content: To see what changed since your last save, run:
diff --git a/index.html b/index.html index 3a4b5c6..7d8e9f0 100644 --- a/index.html +++ b/index.html @@ -12,7 +12,7 @@ -
Git shows the difference between your current files and the last commit.

items: Lines that start with - are what was there before.
Lines that start with + are what replaced them.

blocks.content: In this case, a line was accidentally removed. That single change explains why the page broke.
You can find the issue in seconds.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
